    | timestamp = 00:05:14.019
    | text      = It- it- what's really true is it's more clear that we're not there anymore
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:05:19.019
    | text      = Yeah
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:05:19.519
    | text      = That- it's- we're not at a point where you and I can really work through, uh, some of our greater differences
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:05:25.519
    | text      = Yeah
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:05:26.019
    | text      = And the way that is what made the show interesting and fun
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:05:29.019
    | text      = Yeah
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:05:29.519
    | text      = And to pretend that we can is gonna cause trouble
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:05:33.519
    | text      = And I think that it hurts people
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:05:35.019
    | text      = I mean, they- the thing about comedy duos is that- and this has happened with radio comedy duos for a long time
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:05:42.019
    | text      = Is after a few years, they hate each other's guts
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:05:46.019
    | text      = But then they work together for another 20 years or something like that
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:05:49.519
    | text      = Without ever really speaking to each other
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:05:52.019
    | text      = And I think radio comedy duos or radio duos at all
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:05:55.519
    | text      = A lot of the times have the benefit of being lower stakes
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:05:58.519
    | text      = Mm-hmm
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:05:59.019
    | text      = And the conversations that they're having aren't around things that are really important
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:03.519
    | text      = And people can feel, uh, terribly betrayed by, uh, the, like, the- like if you're talking sports
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:11.019
    | text      = Who cares?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:12.019
    | text      = Well, people care about sports
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:13.519
    | text      = Well, people care about sports, but the universe doesn't care about sports
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:17.519
    | text      = It's in a different way than, um, hatred and, uh, lies and misogyny and transphobia
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:25.519
    | text      = These things are far more real than, uh, sports fandom
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:30.519
    | text      = Mm-hmm
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:31.019
    | text      = And more important to people
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:32.019
    | text      = So when- when they're kind of- I don't think that we disagree on any of those things
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:37.519
    | text      = But they certainly touch on things that we disagree with
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:40.519
    | text      = Sure
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:41.019
    | text      = And- and when those disagreements touch up on things that are really serious and really matter
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:45.519
    | text      = Yeah
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:46.019
    | text      = It's-
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:46.519
    | text      = Yeah
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:47.019
    | text      = It's- you can't just blah blah blah over it, you know?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:49.519
    | text      = No, no
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:50.019
    | text      = There's a- there's a core belief con- conflict and, um, I don't think-
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:54.519
    | text      = I think a lot of people would like the internet to be the internet
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:59.519
    | text      = Where everybody's mad at each other and everybody says, fuck you and I hate you and all that shit
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:05.019
    | text      = And, uh, you know, there's- you can have a core disbelief- or a core belief run up against somebody else's core belief
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:11.519
    | text      = And it's not a hatred
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:13.019
    | text      = Mm-hmm
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:13.519
    | text      = It's just not
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:14.519
    | text      = I don't- I don't feel any ill will whatsoever
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:18.019
    | text      = It's just sometimes you gotta not compromise
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:21.019
    | text      = Mm-hmm
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:21.519
    | text      = Sometimes you just gotta
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:23.019
    | text      = And maybe that's just me
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:24.519
    | text      = Sure
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:25.019
    | text      = But it's, uh, you know, that's kind of how I feel
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:28.019
    | text      = Yeah, and- and to- to whatever extent I have any feeling about that
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:33.019
    | text      = It's that, uh, compromise is a complicated thing
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:38.019
    | text      = And sometimes it involves actual abandonment of the thing you care about
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:43.019
    | text      = And sometimes it doesn't
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:44.519
    | text      = And I think that- I think that we would have been able to compromise on a lot more in the past in a productive way
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:52.519
    | text      = Yeah
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:53.019
    | text      = And, uh, you know, this isn't like a disagreement about, like, you don't like the onion and I- I'm more wishy washy on it
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:00.519
    | text      = No
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:01.019
    | text      = Which I think on the surface some people could probably get that impression
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:04.519
    | text      = Sure
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:05.019
    | text      = And I wanna make sure that no one thinks that
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:06.519
    | text      = Sure
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:07.019
    | text      = Like, um, it's- I- I- I think that, uh, you know, I made my feelings clear
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:14.019
    | text      = Yeah
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:14.519
    | text      = I think that parodying Alex Jones is a difficult game to play
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:17.519
    | text      = I don't know if anyone should but they're the people who are best situated to do it
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:22.519
    | text      = And they, you know, have the blessing of the people that are most importantly impacted by this
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:28.019
    | text      = There you go
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:29.019
    | text      = And, um, I think that because of your very negative and very aggressive response
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:35.019
    | text      = People might have mischaracterized or misunderstood where I was coming from
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:40.019
    | text      = Yes
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:40.519
    | text      = Or what my position was
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:41.519
    | text      = Right
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:42.019
    | text      = So I wanted to make sure that- that, uh, I expressed that
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:45.019
    | text      = Absolutely
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:45.519
    | text      = In a conversation with you
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:47.019
    | text      = Absolutely
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:48.019
    | text      = Um, so yeah, I- I think it's hard, uh, that we're in- we're in a tough spot and, um
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:54.519
    | text      = The world's just a different place too
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:56.519
    | text      = Yeah
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:57.019
    | text      = It's not the same place it was
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:58.519
    | text      = It is not
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:59.019
    | text      = It's just not
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:00.019
    | text      = In some ways the needs of, uh, uh, people are far more severe right now
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:06.519
    | text      = Sure
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:07.019
    | text      = And in some ways the- I think that- any- like, focusing on this brand of misinformation
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:15.019
    | text      = I don't know- I don't know that if it- I don't know if it serves the needs of, uh, those in the world who are most impacted
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:23.019
    | text      = Mm-hmm
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:24.019
    | text      = You know, it's- you wish- change happens
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:28.519
    | text      = It's true
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:29.519
    | text      = Whether you like it or not or whether it's something that you plan for or not, it's- change- change just happens
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:37.019
    | text      = Yeah, and when we set out to do this show, we had no conception of what it was or what it was going to become
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:45.019
    | text      = But I do believe that in our most, uh, basic and, uh, to the ground level of it
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:53.019
    | text      = Mm-hmm
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:53.519
    | text      = We never were like, we're gonna take Alex Jones down
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:57.019
    | text      = Yeah
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:57.519
    | text      = Maybe there was a piece of our interest in what we believed to be doing that was crumbling away the edifice of the fake version of himself that a lot of people believe is real
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:07.019
    | text      = Yes
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:07.519
    | text      = And that's great, and I think we've done a tremendous amount of work on that front
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:11.519
    | text      = Yep
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:12.019
    | text      = But we never set out to destroy him and-
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:16.019
    | text      = Specifically the opposite, your- your initial position has always been like, you know, I'm not here to fucking kill this guy
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:26.519
    | text      = I am here to understand
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:28.519
    | text      = And I think- I think certainly over time we got more, uh, hey fuck this guy
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:32.519
    | text      = Sure, well he earned it
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:34.019
    | text      = Yeah
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:34.519
    | text      = Yeah
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:35.019
    | text      = It was- it was an evolution of, you know, and it makes total sense
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:38.019
    | text      = Yeah
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:38.519
    | text      = Um, but in terms of, you know, what we held as a point that we were doing
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:45.019
    | text      = There's not a failure in not destroying Alex, because I think we all knew that we couldn't
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:51.019
    | text      = Sure
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:51.519
    | text      = That that wasn't something that was going to happen
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:53.019
    | text      = Sure
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:53.519
    | text      = And the only way, essentially, to get people to stop believing in Santa Claus is for people to stop believing in Santa Claus
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:59.519
    | text      = Yeah
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:00.019
    | text      = You can make a thousand podcasts about like, I've been to the North Pole, they're lying
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:05.019
    | text      = I swear to you
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:06.019
    | text      = Right
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:06.519
    | text      = I went to Santa Claus, Indiana, I know what I'm talking about
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:09.519
    | text      = Yep
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:10.019
    | text      = But eventually the only thing that stops this is people who are drawn to it
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:15.519
    | text      = Treating the content and the ideas behind it more reasonably
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:19.519
    | text      = And, uh, with a more, you know, it's a- it's a ultimately consumer based
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:27.519
    | text      = Like where the- where the work is, is the consumer
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:30.019
    | text      = Yep
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:30.519
    | text      = And I think we will be- we would be banging that drum repeatedly were we to just continue and follow on with Alex's stuff
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:39.519
    | text      = Yep
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:40.019
    | text      = Now secondarily, another thing that became a very important piece of this to me through the process of doing
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:48.519
    | text      = Was that I realized that there was no central place where you could go to fact check claims that Alex made about himself
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:57.019
    | text      = Mhm
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:57.519
    | text      = When I started doing this show I had to find hidden RSS feeds that had the old episodes of Alex's show
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:06.519
    | text      = That I could go and consult to fact check these things
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:09.019
    | text      = Mhm
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:09.519
    | text      = And as the process has gone on, there's the KF-
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:14.519
    | text      = Absolutely
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:16.019
    | text      = You can go through every transcript, so yeah
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:18.019
    | text      = Has put together this amazing archive that were that in existence at the time when we started this show
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:26.019
    | text      = The show would still have value, but in terms of pointing out the ability of someone to go back and be like
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:33.019
    | text      = Wait, is that what he said?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:34.519
    | text      = Yeah
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:35.019
    | text      = It is now so easy for people to do that at the Fight Fudgie site
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:43.019
    | text      = I think that the point that I could serve as a archivist or as a resource for journalists who want to do a better job
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:51.019
    | text      = About understanding Alex in a fuller context, I don't serve a purpose in that way anymore
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:59.019
    | text      = And I don't say that in any bitterness or any resentment
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:04.019
    | text      = I think that that site has essentially done the most solid work of what I could have aspired to do in terms of making a wiki
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:14.019
    | text      = Yeah, absolutely
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:15.019
    | text      = And so to me, I think that that is something that has grown out of this and that will live there
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:25.519
    | text      = It covers so many other misinformation people
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:29.519
    | text      = And so people, whatever entertainment loss there is in us not doing the show anymore
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:35.519
    | text      = Real hard, like where the rubber meets the road, facilitating covering this responsibly
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:43.519
    | text      = I believe that that mantle is taken care of
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:46.519
    | text      = Yeah
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:48.019
    | text      = That resource is available for people and that's something that means a lot
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:54.019
    | text      = So I want to publicly thank the person who put that together
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:58.019
    | text      = Yeah
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:59.019
    | text      = Amazing work
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:00.019
    | text      = I didn't do it
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:01.019
    | text      = I mean, if that had been available, I don't know if the questions that you asked that started the show wouldn't have already been answered
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:10.019
    | text      = It would be very easy for me to answer
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:11.519
    | text      = Right, so when we started the show, if that had existed, maybe our show wouldn't exist, so who knows?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:17.019
    | text      = But in the process of finding the answer to like, hey, is Alex racist?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:20.519
    | text      = Or, hey, what does he mean about this thing?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:23.519
    | text      = It would have been much easier for us to come to those, like solve those questions
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:30.519
    | text      = And I think that the charm of the show, a lot of it involves me digging around in shit and who knows what we'll find
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:40.019
    | text      = Absolutely
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:41.019
    | text      = And that never would have been something I did if
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:44.519
    | text      = You already knew what you were going to find
}}

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

}}

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:48.519

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:52.519

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = way through it and they were still kind
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:59.519

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock
